title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Patrick Reed Withdraws
items.text: Patrick Reed withdrew from the BMW PGA Championship during Friday's second round after injuring his wrist/hand when his club struck a tree root on the ninth hole, impacting his Race to Dubai lead and opening an opportunity for Rory McIlroy.

items.headline: Pebble Beach Course Changes
items.text: Pebble Beach has introduced two major changes for this week's Pure Insurance Championship, which players have noticed and commented on.
